fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole 28-foot Sea Ray bowrider powerboat.
findings: Gelcoat on the bow and port side looks clean but slightly flat rather than high-gloss in daylight shots
Possible light hazing/discoloration along the hull sides near the dock line area
Upholstery recently re-covered and looks clean; cockpit and bow seating show little to fix
Snap-in flooring in the cockpit looks clean
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2000 Sea Ray 280 on Lake Minnetonka. The new upholstery looks great, and the gelcoat on the bow and hull sides looks like it could take a deeper shine with a polish and wax. We do pre-sale gelcoat polish and details and can come to you at the dock. Would you like a quote?
